Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

DatedCashFlow.description: An amount paid or received on a date.

amount.description: Amount in currency units; negative for payments, positive for receipts.

effective_annual_growth.description:
The annual growth implied by `growth_per_period`, (1 + g)^m − 1 with m periods a year;
only when the months per period divide 12.

end_date.description:
End date of the period, the first day of the next period, excluded from it (`schedule`
timeline only).

growth_per_period.description:
The growth per period applied into this period, after conversion; absent for period 1
under `period_1`.

start_date.description: Start date of the period, included in it (`schedule` timeline only).

stated_growth.description:
The growth rate of the rule for the step into this period, as stated (before
conversion); absent for period 1 under `period_1`.

value.description: The value of the period, in the units of the base value.

year_fraction.description:
Year fraction of the period under the schedule's day count (`schedule` timeline with a
day count only).

dated_values.description:
With a `schedule` timeline: one `{date, amount}` per period, dated by `timing`, the shape
of `cash_flows` in `tvm.xnpv` and `tvm.xirr`.

months_per_period.description: Months per period, when the timeline has a period length.

periods_per_year.description: Periods a year, when the months per period divide 12.

values.description: The values of periods 1 to n, the shape of `cash_flows` in `tvm.present_value`.
